title: Unmasking the Factual-Conceptual Gap in Persian Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on paired positive (culturally appropriate) and negative (culturally inappropriate) binary scenarios testing identical Persian cultural concepts to measure asymmetric acceptance rates (calculating the difference between acceptance of positive scenarios and rejection of negative scenarios).

Evaluating models using a custom diagnostic benchmark (DIVANBENCH) consisting of factual multiple-choice questions, binary belief verification, and scenario-based reasoning to test deep conceptual understanding versus surface-level pattern matching of Persian superstitions, customs, and social etiquette.
